resume: Playable granular sampler with CLOUD, DUST, TAPE, BLOOM, PULSE and DRIFT modes; 14 factory samples, resampling, MIDI clock and momentary performance effects.

commandes.role: Lower octave. OCT- and OCT+ together undo randomization.
Effects pages. Hold FX and a black key to play a temporary performance effect.
Sample and sweep pages; hold with a key to choose DRIFT ORACLE's key.
Grain shaping. Hold EDIT and a white key to audition the unprocessed sample.
Global clock, MIDI and performance settings.
Overview and playback pages; hold for context-sensitive help.
Sound storage; hold with white keys for user slots 1–16 or black keys for factory presets.
Randomize parameters; hold ARP and turn a knob to lock it.
Choose CLOUD, DUST, TAPE, BLOOM, PULSE or DRIFT.
Play samples chromatically; modifier keys offer live granular effects.

gestes: Select a factory sample, hold a white key and sweep SELECT to move its playhead.
Hold FX and press a black key for a momentary performance effect.
Press PLAY to hear a continuous granular cloud; REC captures the sound for resampling.
a_savoir: ECHOFIELD's companion app has a sample editor; it is not included: the panel gives the instrument and its factory bank.
Powering off with the switch also erases its sounds; Backup and restore keeps a copy.
